metadata.articulation: The sketch release-gap and hold-cap calculations are reproduced for every event without moving note attacks.
metadata.dynamics: The attack/sustain envelope is converted to an equivalent constant per-note strength relative to the 30% source baseline. Current website motor calibration remains authoritative.
metadata.limitation: The current Web Serial protocol cannot transmit separate attack and sustain power values within one note.
metadata.arrangement_scope: Melody only from the supplied single-staff score; no piano accompaniment was invented.
